name: Aether Gust
oracle_text: Choose target spell or permanent that's red or green. Its owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
flavor_text: The chill wind extinguishes flame, and frosts the leaf on the branch.

name: Sudden Setback
oracle_text: The owner of target spell or nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
flavor_text: "Look, buddy, you're not in trouble. I just wanna ask you a questio—"

name: Subtlety
oracle_text:
Flash
Flying
When this creature enters, choose up to one target creature spell or planeswalker spell. Its owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
Evoke—Exile a blue card from your hand.

name: Happy Hogan, Bodyguard
oracle_text:
Vigilance
When Happy Hogan enters, the owner of target creature an opponent controls puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom.

name: Deem Inferior
oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each card you've drawn this turn.
The owner of target nonland permanent puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom.
flavor_text: Forced to behold such a pitiful demonstration of scholarship, Archmage Jeven could hold his tongue no longer.

name: Lost Days
oracle_text: The owner of target creature or enchantment puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom. You create a Clue token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
flavor_text: At every step, his friend was just out of reach.

name: Conflux
oracle_text: Search your library for a white card, a blue card, a black card, a red card, and a green card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
flavor_text: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

name: Shard Convergence
oracle_text: Search your library for a Plains card, an Island card, a Swamp card, and a Mountain card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

name: Gem of Becoming
oracle_text: {3}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for an Island card, a Swamp card, and a Mountain card. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

name: Lotuslight Dancers
oracle_text:
Lifelink
When this creature enters, search your library for a black card, a green card, and a blue card. Put those cards into your graveyard, then shuffle.
flavor_text: They've attained a level of synchronicity beyond what's possible in a single lifetime.

name: Corpse Harvester
oracle_text: {1}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature: Search your library for a Zombie card and a Swamp card, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.

name: Goblin Guide
oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever this creature attacks, defending player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a land card, that player puts it into their hand.
flavor_text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

name: Gate to the Aether
oracle_text: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player reveals the top card of their library. If it's an artifact, creature, enchantment, or land card, the player may put it onto the battlefield.

name: Balshan Beguiler
oracle_text: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player reveals the top two cards of their library. You choose one of those cards and put it into their graveyard.

name: Bamboozle
oracle_text: Target player reveals the top four cards of their library. You choose two of those cards and put them into that player's graveyard. Put the rest on top of their library in any order.

name: Wand of Denial
oracle_text: {T}: Look at the top card of target player's library. If it's a nonland card, you may pay 2 life. If you do, put it into that player's graveyard.
flavor_text: You'll never miss what you never had.

name: Cellar Door
oracle_text: {3}, {T}: Target player puts the bottom card of their library into their graveyard. If it's a creature card, you create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
flavor_text: As if anyone needed another reason to avoid dark, dank cellars.

name: Grenzo, Dungeon Warden
oracle_text:
Grenzo enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
{2}: Put the bottom card of your library into your graveyard. If it's a creature card with power less than or equal to Grenzo's power, put it onto the battlefield.

name: Paroxysm
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller, that player reveals the top card of their library. If that card is a land card, destroy that creature. Otherwise, it gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

name: Prophecy
oracle_text:
Reveal the top card of target opponent's library. If it's a land, you gain 1 life. Then that player shuffles.
Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.

name: Stomping Slabs
oracle_text: Reveal the top seven cards of your library, then put those cards on the bottom of your library in any order. If a card named Stomping Slabs was revealed this way, Stomping Slabs deals 7 damage to any target.

name: Selvala's Charge
oracle_text: Parley — Each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you create a 3/3 green Elephant creature token. Then each player draws a card.

name: Selvala's Enforcer
oracle_text: Parley — When this creature enters, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Then each player draws a card.

name: Rousing of Souls
oracle_text: Parley — Each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. Then each player draws a card.

name: Woodvine Elemental
oracle_text:
Trample
Parley — Whenever this creature attacks, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Then each player draws a card.

name: Dakra Mystic
oracle_text: {U}, {T}: Each player reveals the top card of their library. You may put the revealed cards into their owners' graveyards. If you don't, each player draws a card.
flavor_text: Choices are rarely as simple as they seem.

name: Tainted Pact
oracle_text: Exile the top card of your library. You may put that card into your hand unless it has the same name as another card exiled this way. Repeat this process until you put a card into your hand or you exile two cards with the same name, whichever comes first.

name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
oracle_text: Reveal the top three cards of your library. For each of those cards, put that card into your hand unless any opponent pays 3 life. Then exile the rest.
flavor_text: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

name: Brilliant Ultimatum
oracle_text: Exile the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. You may play lands and cast spells from one of those piles. If you cast a spell this way, you cast it without paying its mana cost.
flavor_text: Revealing the truth only deepened Tezzeret's curiosity for the secrets still buried.

name: Unexpected Results
oracle_text: Shuffle your library, then reveal the top card. If it's a nonland card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield and return Unexpected Results to its owner's hand.
